name: powerprep-quest
description: Gamified study app for Microsoft PL-200 and PL-300 certification exams

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && npm run seed --silent && concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c green,cyan "npm:server" "npm:client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
